description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/sql-querydef-create-texts: Type and ReturnsRecords were read only before the reopen. Asks, for thirteen SQL texts (select, UPDATE, DELETE, INSERT, make-table, DDL, crosstab, union, parameterised select and update, DROP of a missing table, ALTER), what SQL, Type and ReturnsRecords a QueryDef reads right after CreateQueryDef and after the Database is closed and reopened (QueryDefs refreshed, each found by name). Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
